final: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_length, b.avg_length AS baseline_length FROM rating_avgs r CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE r.avg_length > b.avg_length), kept AS (SELECT rating, avg_length, baseline_length, AVG(avg_length) OVER () AS kept_mean FROM above_baseline) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(avg_length - baseline_length) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(avg_length - kept_mean) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM kept WHERE avg_length > kept_mean
